notes.title: 📢 Update v1.2.0 (July 19th, 2025)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Here comes a new update with mechanic improvements and a few balance tweaks based on your suggestions.



In-Game Updates

Cleaning System:

The "Next Step" mechanic has been changed to a Press & Hold system.

Previously, progress would trigger instantly on button press, now it requires holding the button, helping prevent unwanted or accidental progress steps.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148126/cb149540e9ec69892ec6d5513887be03decb70f8.png"]



Tool Detail UI:

Upgrade button now includes clearer info and better visual feedback.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148126/3d72f0a1673e640a22b571564ae3c5eb638e084a.gif"]

Economy:

Sponge upgrade costs have been reduced drastically

UI & Quality of Life:

UX improvements in the upgrade interface


As always, thanks for all your feedback, it really helps shape the game!

More updates coming soon 💙🧽🚗💦

notes.title: 📢 Minor Update v1.1.1 (June 28th, 2025)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Here’s a small update based on recent feedback. Hope it makes your experience smoother and more customizable!



🎮 In-Game Updates

Added sensitivity settings:

Standard camera-look sensitivity

Tool sensitivity

Vehicle camera sensitivity

With 3 different sliders, you can now fine-tune your experience the way you like!



🖥️ UI & Quality of Life

Visual polish for texts inside NPC speech bubbles

Minor environment detail adjustments





Let me know what you think, your feedback is always appreciated!

Thanks for playing 💙🚗💦







You can access sensitivity settings through:
Pause Menu > Options > General

Tool Sensitivity affects mouse-controlled tools like Water Hose, Water Gun, and similar.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148126/19798b8316348607078663a4c6eb9a2d33f669e8.png"]

notes.title: PROLOGUE BIG UPDATE ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!  Here comes one of the final exclusive content update for the Prologue! With this, I'm wrapping it up and shifting my full focus to Early Access.

Here's major things for the update:


  Full language support added for 12 languages
  A new Water Hose is now available for you to try
  High Customer Class upgrade is unlocked
  Bug fixes and improvements



As always, if you run into any bugs or translation issues, don’t hesitate to let me know.

Next stop is Early Access, can’t wait to show you what’s coming next! 

Stay tuned! 💦🧼


Make sure you wishlist it!

notes.title: 📢 Hotfix v1.0.8 (May 8th, 2025)

Let me know what you think, your feedbacks helps me a lot!
